text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Three generations of Takamatsunomiya 
Kinen victories! A monumental 
achievement... Daiichi Ruby, truly 
magnificent!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Now that's what you expect from the 
"Magnificent Clan"! Congratulations~!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you all for your cheers. However, I 
consider this to be a new beginning.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"With the pride of our clan in my heart, I 
will continue to press forward."

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank goodness...! To witness a 
three-generation sweep... I'm so moved...!

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~... Now that I'm relieved, all the 
strength has left my body.

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose this is a good stopping point. 
I'm not too familiar with the races after 
this, so... I will simply pray for them 
from afar."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"...It is still not enough. I must stack 
up even more victories—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ruby!!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Mega congrats~! And we're totally hyped up 
now!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That was super fun, like what the heck!? 
My crush-power is too insane-o!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, she's totally, crazy-crazy 
strong☆ That's why I wuv her, fr fr♪"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hey hey, you can still run, right? Huh? 
Hey hey?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I will retrain myself thoroughly. So 
that from now on, I will not lose to 
"anyone."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios, your running was formidable as 
well. ...If you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "...To nobody? Yourself??"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Doesn't something feel totally off!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah, I lost! I lost, sure, but! It 
was a great match, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Have you ever seen Ojo like this before?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From what I've heard, Daiichi Ruby is 
pushing herself immensely. A half-hearted 
run might not even register to her..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Boring!! I can't get hyped if Milady isn't 
watching!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And nobody even laughed at all!! 
Boo-oo-or-ing~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Uhya!?
choice_data_list: That's Totally Lacking Hype, Isn't It!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me? You're really trying to rile me 
up, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'm a hardcore party animal, 
alright?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Morning hype? Nah, at this point it's way 
past morning, it's dinner time!!
choice_data_list:
Then let's level up our party game even 
more!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If I do that, young lady, will ya totally 
stan me!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"By the time I clash with Daiichi Ruby 
again, I'll become an overwhelming 
presence. To hone my party-people vibe, 
I'll aim for the prelude to the Yasuda 
Kinen, which she'll surely target too――"
choice_data_list: Let's bring the hype at the Milers Cup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the next target race was decided: 
the Yomiuri Milers Cup.
